why: Третье условное — это разговор о прошлом, которое уже нельзя изменить: «Если бы я тогда знал, я бы поступил иначе». В русском для этого есть «бы», а в английском нужна целая конструкция из двух частей, которая выражает сожаление, упрёк или оправдание.
formation: • If + Past Perfect (had + V3), would have + V3
• If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.
• Отрицание: If I hadn't left late, I wouldn't have missed the train.
• Вопрос: What would you have done if you had lost your job? / Would you have come if I had invited you?
• Части можно поменять местами, запятая нужна только когда if-часть стоит первой: I would have helped you if you had asked.
• Вместо would можно использовать could или might: If we had left earlier, we could have seen the sunrise. (мы бы смогли) / ... we might have seen it. (возможно, увидели бы)
• В речи: I'd = I had или I would, поэтому по смыслу выбираем нужное: If I'd known (had), I'd have told you (would).
usage: 1. Сожаление о прошлом: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam. (Если бы я больше занимался, я бы сдал экзамен.)
2. Упрёк другому человеку: If you had told me, I would have helped. (Если бы ты сказал, я бы помог.)
3. Объяснение причины события: The bug wouldn't have reached production if we had tested the code. (Баг не попал бы в продакшен, если бы мы протестировали код.)
4. Неуверенный результат (could / might): If she had called, we might have solved it. (Если бы она позвонила, мы, возможно, решили бы это.)
signalWords: yesterday, last week, in 2020, then, at that time — любые слова о прошлом, а также слова if only и wish о прошлом (их разберём в теме про wish). Фраза «но этого не случилось» всегда подразумевается.
mistakes: ✗ If I would have known, I would have told you. → ✓ If I had known, I would have told you. (would нельзя ставить в if-часть)
✗ If she had studied, she would pass. → ✓ ... she would have passed. (во второй части нужен would have + V3)
✗ If we had went earlier... → ✓ If we had gone earlier... (после had нужна третья форма: gone, а не went)
✗ If he had a car yesterday, he would have come. → ✓ If he had had a car yesterday... (Past Perfect от have — had had)
✗ What would you done? → ✓ What would you have done? (have пропускать нельзя)
remember: Прошлое нельзя изменить, поэтому с обеих сторон прошлое: If + had V3, would have V3; и никаких would в if-части.

exercises.instruction: Поставьте глаголы в правильную форму (третье условное)

items.prompt: If I ___ (leave) earlier, I ___ (not miss) the train.
items.answer: had left, wouldn't have missed

items.prompt: If she ___ (study) harder, she ___ (pass) the exam.
items.answer: had studied, would have passed

items.prompt: We ___ (go) to the beach if the weather ___ (be) better.
items.answer: would have gone, had been

items.prompt: If they ___ (not forget) the password, they ___ (log in).
items.answer: hadn't forgotten, would have logged in

items.prompt: If you ___ (call) me, I ___ (help) you.
items.answer: had called, would have helped

items.prompt: He ___ (not break) his leg if he ___ (be) more careful.
items.answer: wouldn't have broken, had been

items.prompt: If I ___ (have) more time, I ___ (finish) the project.
items.answer: had had, would have finished

items.prompt: If the developers ___ (test) the code, they ___ (find) the bug.
items.answer: had tested, would have found

items.prompt: If I (a) knew (b) had known about the party, I would have come.
items.answer: (b) had known

items.prompt: She would have called if she (a) had had (b) would have had your number.
items.answer: (a) had had

items.prompt: If we (a) hadn't taken (b) didn't take a taxi, we would have been late.
items.answer: (a) hadn't taken

items.prompt: I (a) would have bought (b) would buy the jacket if it had been cheaper.
items.answer: (a) would have bought

items.prompt: If he (a) had gone (b) had went to bed earlier, he wouldn't have been tired.
items.answer: (a) had gone

items.prompt: What (a) would you have done (b) would you do if you had lost your job?
items.answer: (a) would you have done

items.prompt: If it (a) hadn't rained (b) wouldn't have rained, we would have had the picnic.
items.answer: (a) hadn't rained

items.prompt: They (a) wouldn't have won (b) wouldn't win the game if they hadn't played so well.
items.answer: (a) wouldn't have won

items.prompt: He didn't wear a coat, so he caught a cold.
items.answer: If he had worn a coat, he wouldn't have caught a cold.

items.prompt: We missed the bus, so we were late.
items.answer: If we hadn't missed the bus, we wouldn't have been late.

items.prompt: She didn't save the file, so she lost her work.
items.answer: If she had saved the file, she wouldn't have lost her work.

items.prompt: I didn't have a map, so I got lost.
items.answer: If I had had a map, I wouldn't have gotten lost.

items.prompt: They didn't book a hotel, so they slept in the car.
items.answer: If they had booked a hotel, they wouldn't have slept in the car.

items.prompt: He drove too fast, so he got a ticket.
items.answer: If he hadn't driven so fast, he wouldn't have gotten a ticket.

items.prompt: I was hungry because I didn't have breakfast.
items.answer: If I had had breakfast, I wouldn't have been hungry.

items.prompt: The team didn't meet the deadline because the client changed the requirements.
items.answer: If the client hadn't changed the requirements, the team would have met the deadline.

items.prompt: If I would have known, I would have told you.
items.answer: If I had known, I would have told you.

items.prompt: If she had studied, she would pass the test.
items.answer: If she had studied, she would have passed the test.

items.prompt: If we had went earlier, we would have seen him.
items.answer: If we had gone earlier, we would have seen him.

items.prompt: If he had a car yesterday, he would have come.
items.answer: If he had had a car yesterday, he would have come.

items.prompt: I would have helped you if you would have asked.
items.answer: I would have helped you if you had asked.

items.prompt: If they hadn't miss the flight, they wouldn't have been late.
items.answer: If they hadn't missed the flight, they wouldn't have been late.

items.prompt: What would you done if you had lost your passport?
items.answer: What would you have done if you had lost your passport?

items.prompt: If I had seen the message, I would replied.
items.answer: If I had seen the message, I would have replied.

items.prompt: Если бы я знал, я бы тебе сказал.
items.answer: If I had known, I would have told you.

items.prompt: Если бы мы выехали раньше, мы бы не опоздали.
items.answer: If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have been late.

items.prompt: Если бы ты сохранил файл, ты бы не потерял работу.
items.answer: If you had saved the file, you wouldn't have lost your work.

items.prompt: Что бы ты сделал, если бы потерял паспорт?
items.answer: What would you have done if you had lost your passport?

items.prompt: Она получила бы эту работу, если бы лучше подготовилась к собеседованию.
items.answer: She would have gotten the job if she had prepared better for the interview.

items.prompt: Если бы не было пробок, мы бы приехали вовремя.
items.answer: If there hadn't been traffic, we would have arrived on time. / If there hadn't been a traffic jam, we would have arrived on time.

items.prompt: Баг не попал бы в продакшен, если бы мы проверили код.
items.answer: The bug wouldn't have gotten into production if we had checked the code.

items.prompt: Если бы я не заболел, я бы поехал с вами в отпуск.
items.answer: If I hadn't gotten sick, I would have gone on vacation with you. / If I hadn't been sick, I would have gone on vacation with you.
